The '''M1C-F claymore mine''' was a type of fragmentation land mine produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Simple yet powerful, its detonation was triggered by motion sensors, and ejected razor-sharp pieces of metals.
